headline: US adds Alibaba subsidiary and Megaspeed to its blacklist, linked to Nvidia scandal
summary: The EU has blacklisted an Alibaba subsidiary and Megaspeed, linked to the Nvidia chip scandal. Megaspeed, under investigation since 2024 over possible AI chip diversion to China, now needs US Commerce Department authorisation for US exports.
why: Nvidia is the leading supplier of AI accelerator chips, and export controls on China-linked buyers directly affect its sales. Alibaba is a major Chinese cloud and e-commerce group.

impacts.name: Alibaba
impacts.why: A subsidiary of Alibaba has been placed on the EU blacklist.
